desc:
👍Rate if you like APS!
ANIME PIXEL SHOWDOWN

⚔️ 27 pixel anime fighters, each with their own combos, specials and ultimates. First to 3 rounds wins!

🎮 CONTROLS (PC)
A / D: Move | S: Crouch
W / Space: Jump | S then Space: Super Jump
Double tap A / D: Dash
Left Click: Light Attack
Right Click: Heavy Attack
Q: Special Attack
F: Block (or hold back)
H: Charge Ki
U: Ultimate | I / O: Ultimate 2 / 3
E: Assist (some fighters)
Z X C V B G: Special Moves

Pro tip: S then D (or S then A) + an attack also does the specials.
Chain light, heavy and air attacks into specials to discover new combos. Fill your Ki bar and finish with your Ultimate!

📱 Mobile and 🎮 controller supported. Change any key in SETTINGS.

🔥 Online 1v1s, Raids, Training, Battle Pass, Daily Rewards and more!
